title: Colorectal Cancer
subtitle: StewardMD ONCOTREE navigator (draft)
provenanceNote: ONCOTREE navigator DRAFT for colorectal adenocarcinoma. Captures setting/stage and, for metastatic disease, mismatch-repair (MMR/MSI) status, then routes to APPLICABLE existing StewardMD Standard Protocols by reference (fluoropyrimidine-oxaliplatin/irinotecan backbones; pembrolizumab for deficient-MMR/MSI-high metastatic disease). Invents no dose/regimen/criterion. Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Colon/Rectal Cancer; no proprietary content reproduced. DRAFT - not clinically activated; physician decides.
sourceNote: Structural pathway consistent with Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Colon/Rectal Cancer. Options reference existing StewardMD Standard Protocols and their own evidence layers.

nodes.title: Setting and stage
nodes.description: Adjuvant chemotherapy for resected high-risk stage II / stage III disease is curative-intent; stage IV (metastatic) disease is treated with palliative intent and guided by molecular testing.

nodes.title: Mismatch-repair (MMR / MSI) status
nodes.description: Deficient mismatch repair (dMMR) / microsatellite-instability-high (MSI-H) metastatic colorectal cancer is an indication for first-line immunotherapy; proficient MMR (pMMR / MSS) disease is treated with chemotherapy.

nodes.title: Adjuvant: fluoropyrimidine-oxaliplatin
nodes.description: Adjuvant fluoropyrimidine-oxaliplatin chemotherapy (FOLFOX) for resected high-risk stage II / stage III colon cancer. Physician selects; the existing dose engine computes doses.

nodes.title: dMMR / MSI-high metastatic: immunotherapy
nodes.description: Deficient-MMR / MSI-high metastatic colorectal cancer - first-line immunotherapy (pembrolizumab). Physician selects.

nodes.name: pMMR/MSS metastatic colorectal
nodes.title: pMMR / MSS metastatic: chemotherapy backbones
nodes.description: Proficient-MMR / MSS metastatic colorectal cancer - fluoropyrimidine-based chemotherapy backbones (oxaliplatin or irinotecan). Physician selects; targeted agents by RAS/BRAF/HER2 status are considered separately.
